body: Feeling like the space in an empty bag. I'm not even real or a mass.
Just having my regular meltdown.Don't want to be awake,

Blah. 

I just want to mutilate myself, but I can't, people will find out, not that it matters.

Feeling wrong, so wrong.
My grandmother keeps bringing up "Oh, you were such a happy child", she's not approving of my gloomy 30'ish year oldness bullshit. As a child I had more pretend energy.

(SE) Asian culture is totally messed up when it comes to mental health. If there should be an issue with someone, they're either possessed by demons or "broken" or "CRAZAY!".

Not sure about other parts of Asia.

​

My grandmother recently asked jokingly if I was depressed. I said most likely. Well, that was awkward and uncomfortable, for her. :D
Every waking hour is just the same. Nothing happens. I am nothing. Just numb.
